cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.14)
project(runner LANGUAGES CXX)

# Define the application target. To change its name, change BINARY_NAME in the
# top-level CMakeLists.txt (generated by `flutter create`), not the value here,
# or `flutter run` will no longer work.
add_executable(${BINARY_NAME} WIN32
  "flutter_window.cpp"
  "main.cpp"
  "utils.cpp"
  "win32_window.cpp"
  "${FLUTTER_MANAGED_DIR}/generated_plugin_registrant.cc"
  "Runner.rc"
  "runner.exe.manifest"
)

# Apply the standard set of build settings. This can be removed for applications
# that need different build settings.
apply_standard_settings(${BINARY_NAME})

# Disable Windows macros that collide with C++ standard library functions.
target_compile_definitions(${BINARY_NAME} PRIVATE "NOMINMAX")

# Add dependency libraries and include directories. Add any application-specific
# dependencies here.
target_link_libraries(${BINARY_NAME} PRIVATE flutter flutter_wrapper_app)
target_link_libraries(${BINARY_NAME} PRIVATE "dwmapi.lib")
target_include_directories(${BINARY_NAME} PRIVATE "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}")

# Run the Flutter tool portions of the build. This must not be removed.
add_dependencies(${BINARY_NAME} flutter_assemble)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# FastFlow: bundle the Go VPN engine DLL next to the runner .exe.
#
# The DLL is produced by `make engine-windows` into windows/vpn_engine.dll
# (CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR is the top-level windows/ dir during the flutter build).
# Copying it into $<TARGET_FILE_DIR> means it lands next to the built .exe for
# both `flutter run` and the release output that `flutter build windows`
# packages — so DynamicLibrary.open('vpn_engine.dll') resolves at runtime.
#
# Guarded by EXISTS so configuring before the engine is built does not fail;
# build the engine first (see the Makefile) for the copy to run.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
set(VPN_ENGINE_DLL "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/vpn_engine.dll")
if(EXISTS "${VPN_ENGINE_DLL}")
  add_custom_command(TARGET ${BINARY_NAME} POST_BUILD
    COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E copy_if_different
      "${VPN_ENGINE_DLL}"
      "$<TARGET_FILE_DIR:${BINARY_NAME}>/vpn_engine.dll"
    VERBATIM
    COMMENT "Bundling vpn_engine.dll next to ${BINARY_NAME}.exe")
else()
  message(WARNING
    "vpn_engine.dll not found at ${VPN_ENGINE_DLL}; "
    "run `make engine-windows` before `flutter build windows` to bundle the VPN engine.")
endif()
